data.title: 卡莲 · 冬日雪街的热可可小憩
data.description: 【卡莲 · 冬日雪街的热可可小憩】白雪覆盖的商店街长椅旁，卡莲双手捧着热可可纸杯，在啜饮后停下脚步回头。短短的银白发梢露在毛线帽边，红色大衣挡住寒风；她的琥珀色眼眸在路灯下泛起一丝安宁的笑意。
data.location: 银装素裹、华灯初上的冬日商店街街角长椅
data.action: 啜饮后双手稳住纸杯，停在长椅旁回头微笑
data.lighting: 街边暖黄路灯与初雪反光的清冽微芒
data.camera: cowboy shot, eye level, peaceful winter street view
data.promptProse: Beside the snowy shopping-street bench, Caren pauses after sipping hot chocolate and turns toward the viewer, both hands wrapped around the cup beneath her chin. Short silver strands show below her white beanie and closed red duffle coat. The eye-level cowboy view includes the bench and falling first snow. Warm streetlamp light softens her amber eyes and cup, contrasting with cool snow reflections and her small breath cloud.
